title: New Schaff-Herzog Encyclopedia of Religious Knowledge
tradition_notes: The New Schaff-Herzog (1908-1914) is the leading English-language Protestant reference work of the early 20th century. Based on German Realencyklopaedie fuer protestantische Theologie und Kirche (3rd ed.), with significant English additions. Broadly ecumenical Reformed/Lutheran scholarship.
notes: All 13 volumes published 1908-1914. US public domain (pre-1928). Vol. 13 is a general index. Permission confirmed by CCEL (Quincy, 2026-04-01). Pilot: vols 1-2 processed. Full 13-volume acquisition in a follow-up session.
